key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.03s): Initial archival pose of ice-cream; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=4.15s): Mid-sequence articulation of ice-cream; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=5.39s): Peak dynamic extension of ice-cream over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=6.63s): Follow-through and settle of ice-cream with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of ice-cream (3.03s..6.63s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
